neighbours.label: Whether a measure or account faithfully represents reality: false, skew, representative, accurately reflect, distorted
fire: Failing to adjust for age can give a false picture of the disease.
Outliers can badly skew the results of a small survey.
The poll was designed to be representative of all voters.
Critics doubt the map accurately reflects the border.
Does this graph give a fair impression of the company's growth?
The thermometer near the stove gave an inaccurate reading of the room.
The statistics paint a distorted picture of crime in the city.
The photograph is a true representation of how the village looked.
quiet: Failing to adjust for age can cause a delay in the diagnosis of the disease.
Outliers can slow the analysis of a small survey.
The poll was designed to be short for all voters.
Critics doubt the map includes the border.
Does this graph have a blue legend for the company's growth?
The thermometer near the stove gave a high reading of the room.
The statistics cover a decade of crime in the city.
The photograph is a small print of how the village looked.

predictions: Words about faithful or distorted representation fire; neutral statements about the same measure stay quiet.
